s: Prometheus, Grafana, logging, tracing, alerting, SLOs
d: If you can't observe your system, you can't fix it. Three pillars: Logs (what happened), Metrics (how much/how fast), Traces (which path). Tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry help detect issues before users do.
c: Log levels: DEBUG INFO WARN ERROR FATAL
The 4 Golden Signals (latency, traffic, errors, saturation)

p: Monitoring and Observability give you x-ray vision into your backend. Without it, you are flying blind when production goes down. It consists of Metrics, Logs, and Traces.
1. Metrics: Numbers over time (CPU usage, Error rates). Tools: Prometheus, Grafana.
2. Logs: Event records (Error stacks). Tools: ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).
3. Traces: Following a request across microservices. Tools: Jaeger, DataDog.

// Prometheus Metric Example
const counter = new promClient.Counter({
  name: 'http_requests_total',
  help: 'Total HTTP requests',
  labelNames: ['method', 'status']
});
counter.inc({ method: 'GET', status: 200 });
